messages:
alex_support: Hey team — customer ACME Inc (acct: acct_9Zx) says free-trial can't be granted. Checkout blocked with 'payment required' even after they added a card. Can someone look?

maria_billing: I can repro from billing UI. When we attempt to create PaymentIntent it moves to requires_action then immediately to requires_payment_method with no challenge delivered to the user. No 3DS flow prompt.

sam_payments: That sounds like the issuer is cancelling the challenge via an out-of-band notification. Do we have the PaymentIntent / webhook logs?

payments-bot: webhook: payment_intent.updated pi_1J2l0N... status=requires_payment_method code=3ds_challenge_cancelled provider=stripe region=eu-west-1

priya_sre: Pasting the debug trace from the billing-service for the attempt:
```
2026-02-15T14:04:22Z INFO create_payment_intent user=acct_9Zx amount=0 metadata={trial_grant:true}
2026-02-15T14:04:24Z WARN pi_1J2l0N status=requires_action next_action=use_stripe_sdk
2026-02-15T14:04:25Z ERROR pi_1J2l0N status=requires_payment_method reason=3ds_challenge_cancelled
```

alex_support: The customer timeline: they enter card details -> click confirm -> nothing appears, page stays on spinner ~10s -> then UI shows "Payment failed" and trial not granted. They tried 3 different cards and same result.

maria_billing: They were using EU test issuer? She said her card is a EU bank. Maybe SCA behaviour combined with our on-page SDK race condition.

sam_payments: Two hypotheses: 1) our front-end is timing out before the issuer completes the challenge and cancels; 2) issuer sends a consumer-initiated cancel (e.g., user closes 3DS prompt), but the frontend doesn't present it. Need to check stripe.js events.

priya_sre: Can the customer share browser console logs? Also which browser + adblockers. I pushed a small tracing build to staging to log stripe.js events to console:
```
window.addEventListener('stripe:events', e => console.log('stripe-event', e.detail))
```

alex_support: I asked customer for console + screenshot. They've sent video showing spinner -> error. No 3DS modal visible. They said "I didn't close any prompt".

sam_payments: For immediate mitigation I can issue a manual trial grant and refund any preauth. Can you confirm we should do that? Ticket #SUP-4219.

maria_billing: Yes please grant trial and add note: "manual grant due to 3DS challenge not presented by frontend, possible issuer-cancelled flow". Also set customer to 'requires_manual_followup' so we don't auto-charge.

priya_sre: Operational note: adding an automated retry window for requires_action -> requires_payment_method transitions might help. For example, keep PI alive for 10s and poll for next_action before concluding failure. Current code times out at 3s.

sam_payments: I deployed a quick config change to increase timeout to 12s on staging for the trial flow. We should validate with EU test card that triggers slow 3DS flows.

alex_support: Customer confirmed manual trial grant fixed their onboarding for now. They asked for root cause/ETA.

sam_payments: Next steps: (1) collect stripe.js event logs from customer or run remote session, (2) add server-side safeguard to wait for delayed challenges (config-driven), (3) add telemetry to count how often PI jumps to requires_payment_method with reason=3ds_challenge_cancelled. I'll open a follow-up PR and link here.

maria_billing: I've credited a one-month trial (internal note: billing_action=manual_trial_grant by maria_billing, ref SUP-4219). Customer happy for now.

priya_sre: Filed infra ticket to add a metric: payments.3ds.cancelled_rate and an alert when >0.5% per region. Also assigning to sam_payments for root cause under payments epic.

payments-bot: created incident: PAY-312 (priority=low) assigned_to=sam_payments

alex_support: Thanks all. I'll close the support ticket after we have the PR link and the metric. Leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
